resources.string: Member changes
Only the channel\'s admins and workspace admins change members
Every member\'s app accepts member changes from any member

When this is on, every member\'s app checks each change to the members itself: only the channel\'s admins add and remove people, moderators only remove members, and workspace owners and admins keep both. Nobody else, and not the server, can add someone. It doesn\'t stop members from passing on what they can read.
Admin
Moderator
Turn on
Turn on admin-only member changes? The people listed above lose what is named next to them. Only the channel\'s admins or a workspace owner or admin can turn it off again.
Turn off
Turn off admin-only member changes? Any member\'s app can then add and remove people again.
Only workspace owners and admins can turn this on. Ask one of them.
Nobody who changes members today loses that.
Who loses what when it is on:
can no longer add or remove people
can only remove members, not add anyone
Give at least one person in the channel the admin role first.
